searchText: does anyone know if the launchpad deposit cli program, used a 25th word by default or not? ie a default passphrase don't think so, just 24 wouldn't it make sense to add a way for people to transfer their ownership from one root seed to another, being able to add a passphrase to their seeds? currently most everybody have 24 seeds, which when written down for backups are really insecure if fallen into the wrong hands 24 word seeds* How do you transfer ownership by just adding an extra word? i didn't mean that functionality exists, but generally speaking i think what im suggesting is the equivalent of having withdrawals? I'm not even sure tbh what is required for that to be an option in the deposit contract but it seems like it would make sense to think about this problem <@!489217181104734219> I think what you're talking about is the ability to change withdrawal credentials for an active validator. That would be something that happened Ethereum 2. It is an option technically, but it brings with it the danger of unintentionally enabling transfers. <@!144468805697929216> i think what i'm referring to is equivalent, tho withdrawls or transfers isn't what I had in mind. It was more of a security standpoint/conversation
